title: About Us – Vino&Co
description: About Us The Vino&Co wine experience agency is a team of like-minded people led by oenologist and sommelier Eynat Klein. We are united by a love for Israel
h2: We are looking for passionate creative people.
texts: The Vino&Co wine experience agency is a team of like-minded people led by oenologist and sommelier Eynat Klein.

We are united by a love for Israel and Israeli winemaking, a passion for exceptional wines, and a desire to take the culture of tasting beyond the usual. We don’t just organize events – we create an atmosphere, emotions, and a narrative where every glass becomes part of a fascinating story.
We promote Israeli winemaking and specialize in presenting wines that you are unlikely to find on supermarket shelves.

Each of our evenings is a unique project with many specially selected components, whether it’s music, a special guest, gastronomy, or the venue. For us, there are no minor details in creating wine experiences.

Behind every tasting is a team of professional sommeliers deeply immersed in global oenology. We guarantee impeccable taste, impeccable service, and a level of expertise that turns getting to know wine into a real discovery.
Vino&Co is the choice for those who value exclusivity, seek a deep immersion in wine culture without excessive snobbery, and are ready for impressions that will be remembered for a long time.
